text:
zoe: Quick sync 7 Ignite seed plan: experiment two credit buckets + one prompt starter pack. Measure 7-day activation (first gen success). Need copy, tracking events, and webinar CTA routing. whos in?
mike: I can do tracking. canonical events: `signup_channel`, `ignite_cohort`, `credit_amount`, `prompt_pack`, `first_gen_ok`. add `nudge_shown` and `activation_met`.
ana: Cohorts: tiny50 = 50 credits + starter, big300 = 300 credits + curated, ctrl = none. Split by source: blog, socials, webinar. Primary KPI: activation_met within 7 days. Secondary: avg tokens first session.
chris: Copy quick drafts:
- Micro: "Ignite is live 7 grab free credits + starter prompts to prototype fast. Join our quick kickoff webinar. -> [link]"
- Longer: "Prototype LLM features in minutes with Ignite: free credits and curated prompt packs. Live demo in our short webinar 7 reserve your spot -> [link]"
zoe: CTA text = "Reserve my seat" for webinar links. Use UTMs: `utm_campaign=ignite_seed&utm_medium=social&utm_source=post`.
mike: Ill add `ignite_exposed=true` to user props and push experiment flags. Timeline: schema ready Wed EOD, flags Friday AM.
nana: Sampling: deterministic hash on user_id so cohort stable. target N: 5k total (approx 3000/1000/1000). Ill drop allocation script.
chris: Recommend 3-email webinar nurture: reminder, 1hr, last-call. Also post-webinar follow-up with quickstart link that auto-applies credits.
ops-bot: Created campaign record `marketing::ignite_seed` and scheduled reminder at 1900005000.
zoe: Great. Action items:
- @mike: push schema + flags (due Wed EOD)
- @chris: finalize 2 post variants + 3-email copy (due Thu noon)
- @ana: confirm sampling script + targets (due Thu EOD)
- @zoe: create CRM campaign + UTM checklist (due Thu EOD)
Run window 14 days, snapshot at day 14 (activation_rate, tokens_first_week, D14 retention). Thanks team :rocket:
